title: Fireline install sprint — bridge / daily brief
content:
Daily bridge notes for Fireline cohort install sprint — compact summary for execs and field engineers

Date: 2028-07-12
Bridge host: Aisha Kapoor
Attendees: Aisha, Ben M., Eleni, Marcus, Ravi, Customer A success lead (Anya), Onsite tech (Julio)
Duration: 25m (standup-style)

1) Quick status headlines
- Cohort: Fireline (customer A, B, internal lab node) — day 3 of 5 install window.
- Top-level: hardware racks racked and cabled at Site-A, nodes passed BIOS checks; infra network ACLs partially applied (see blocker).
- Customer traffic validation in progress for Customer A (pre-prod) — 56% of test flows passed smoke tests.

2) Deep-dive by lane
A) Networking / Onsite connectivity (owner: Ben Morales)
- Symptom: Intermittent BGP session drops when enabling the customer eBGP peer during scale test.
- Triage so far: observed asymmetric route advertisement from site spine during heavy SYN burst; likely switch firmware micro-behavior under multicast storm (logs attached in Confluence page).
- Temporary mitigation: rate-limit eBGP session bring-up (config PR queued).
- Action: Ben to open PD-4480 with site switch vendor, escalate to field firmware team by EOD 2028-07-12.

B) Install orchestration / automation (owner: Eleni Kostas)
- Symptom: One node failed post-provisioning late customization (private CA cert install step timed out).
- Root cause: downstream Vault token TTL mismatch when rotating CA on install runner.
- Workaround: manual cert injection completed for node-07; added a retry wrapper to installer.
- Action: Eleni to push hotfix to infra repo (PR 918 linked) and validate across 3 nodes by 2028-07-13.

C) Observability / Logs (owner: Marcus Li)
- Symptom: Collector flappers after enabling site-specific SSM agent profile.
- Triage: memory pressure spikes correlate with log-forwarder backpressure; config was using debug-level for all containers.
- Fix: switch forwarder to info-level, enable backpressure queueing feature flag.
- Action: Marcus to deploy config change to Site-A canaries and monitor 4-hour window.

3) Customer blockers (top-priority)
- Blocker 1: Customer A cannot complete end-to-end pre-prod flows when eBGP is enabled (impact: prevents full sign-off). => Action: Ben + onsite Julio to run controlled BGP sessions with vendor patch; target window 2028-07-13 02:00–04:00 UTC.
- Blocker 2: Network inventory mismatch — asset tags on two switches swapped in rack manifest (impact: cable tracing overhead). => Action: Julio to re-verify rack labels and update inventory sheet; expected complete 2028-07-12 18:00 local.

4) Risk and escalation notes
- Risk: If vendor cannot provide firmware patch within 72 hours, we will pivot to an overlay routing fallback: implement static aggregation on top-of-rack to reduce BGP churn. Estimated extra 6 hours of field work and 2 engineer-days of followup.
- Escalation: If eBGP remains unstable past 2028-07-13 06:00 UTC, escalate to SRE on-call (pager) and engage Solutions Eng for a temporary managed proxi route.

5) Action item tracker (owner — due date — status)
- PD-4480 (Ben) — 2028-07-12 — open (vendor contact started).
- Hotfix PR 918 (Eleni) — 2028-07-13 — in_review.
- Collector config prodify (Marcus) — 2028-07-13 — pending rollout.
- Rack inventory correction (Julio) — 2028-07-12 18:00 — assigned.
- Runbook update: add BGP bring-up safe-mode checklist (Aisha) — 2028-07-14 — draft.

6) Notes to field engineers / playbook snippets
- BGP bring-up safe-mode: enable neighbor with route-refresh off, confirm route counts < 2000 before enabling full exchange, leave community stripping rule enabled.
- Vault cert rotation: prefer ephemeral install token with 24-hour TTL during initial bootstrap; if using long-lived tokens, ensure re-issue on every runner restart.

7) Dependencies and cross-team asks
- Firmware vendor (vendor-ticket #VND-2321) needs to confirm reproducibility on Lab-Spine-3. Ben to provide pcap and session logs.
- Platform-ops to approve emergency overlay routing change (P0 config) if vendor patch delayed.

8) Parking lot / non-blocking items
- Consider toggling prefix-aggregation on per-customer policy to reduce BGP churn for small deployments. (discussion item for retro)
- Collect sample traffic traces from Customer B for longer retention (ask Customer Success for permission).

Summary: progress steady; highest risk is the eBGP instability. Primary immediate work: Ben + vendor escalation; Eleni hotfix rollout; Marcus collector config change. Bridge reconvene 2028-07-13 09:30 UTC unless a P0 escalation triggers earlier.

Appendix: quick links
- Confluence runbook: /deployments/private/runbooks/fireline-install
- PI visibility board: https://linear.app/redwood/board/fireline-installs
- Related tickets: PD-4421 (site readiness checklist), PD-4480 (BGP flapping), VND-2321 (vendor lab reproduction)

Notes to self: preserve trial of overlay fallback in a sandbox and capture time-to-failover metrics (important for customer SLAs).
